name: Hotel Prince de Galles
positioning: Art Deco hotel on Avenue George V in Paris, officially Prince de Galles, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Paris, with a mosaic courtyard protected as a historical monument
best_for: Travelers who want Art Deco design within walking distance of the Champs-Elysees
Guests who value suites with Eiffel Tower views and a Les Clefs d'Or concierge

facts.text: The hotel is on Avenue George V in the heart of Paris, within walking distance of the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs-Elysees.
The hotel has welcomed guests such as Winston Churchill, Marlene Dietrich and royalty.
The lobby has gold-leaf chandeliers and marble floors.
Many of the rooms and suites have private balconies with views of the Paris cityscape.
The marble bathrooms feature mosaics inspired by the Art Deco era.
Rooms have toiletries from the Lalique collection.
The Suite d'Or has gold and black accents celebrating French craftsmanship.
The Macassar Suite has powder blue walls with molding and a fireplace in its living area.
The concierge team are members of Les Clefs d'Or.
The fitness center is open 24/7 and offers personalized coaching.
Michelin-starred chef Akira Back opened his first restaurant in Europe at the hotel in 2022.
Restaurant & Bar 19.20 by Norbert Tarayre is centered on Paris in the 1920s.

highlights.text: Le Patio's architecture has remained intact since 1929 and is protected as a historical monument by the Batiments de France.
The composer Chopin lived in the building that once stood on the hotel's site, in an apartment just above the current Patio.
Created in collaboration with Lalique, the Suite Lalique by Patrick Hellmann has views of Paris including the Eiffel Tower.
The Wellness Suite was created with practitioners from CALMA PARIS, known for its Mediterranean orange-blossom method.
Each bathroom has a different marble scheme, from Italian Carrara to black and pink marble from the Pyrenees.

considerations.text: A Wellness Suite takes the place of a full spa, offering personalized treatments.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
Breakfast is served at Le Patio for a fee.
